L1: Did an additional target source event occur within the task event_window_s? Existing background anomalies alone do not establish an event.
L2: Report a measured node with additional source-attributable fdom excess >=0.02, or an explicit empty affected set. The counterfactual is private.
L3: Identify the registered forcing family. Mechanism identifiability has not yet been certified.
L4: Locate the physical release face on the bed or computational window boundary; a receiving water-column node is not itself the release location. Coordinates may be between navigation nodes.
L5: Selective source declaration. A proposed coordinate requires a numeric joint probability that a source exists and the coordinate is within tolerance. When source_position is null, source_confidence may be null; no invented location confidence is required. source_presence_probability always remains a numeric probability, including when uncertain. Report coverage, false-declaration risk, Brier score and risk-coverage, not an abstention pass leaderboard. declare means affirming a present source at source_position, never announcing source absence. For absent/uncertain source location use cannot_determine; absence detection is scored through L1.
forecast_policy: Model-derived values are predictions, never observations.
pricing_basis: conservative proxy CNY3 input/CNY9 output per million, no cache discount; local cost zero
grid_context_policy: Full native grid first; exact local window only when the registered context capacity is exceeded.
